summary: Iteration 10: end-to-end verification of Driver KYC document upload + admin approval feature. Both backend (pytest, 5/5 incl. new 404 cases) and frontend Playwright flows pass. All 5 review-request scenarios verified working: upload UI states + Next/Submit gating, pending-driver online block (403), admin approval tab with docs view, document access control (owner/admin 200, non-owner 403, non-existent 404), and admin approve promotes user_type to driver.

minor.issue: Returns 500 (likely ObjectId/serialization) after the user is promoted to driver. Out of this review's scope but observed in console during admin flow.
Pre-existing 500 (ObjectId not JSON serializable) — same as iteration_9, still present.

action_items: (Optional, out of scope) Fix /api/drivers/me 500 (likely Mongo _id ObjectId in response) — exclude _id or cast to str. Same fix needed for /api/admin/users and /api/admin/orders.
critical_code_review_comments: DriverOnboarding.js: handleFileUpload uploads each file immediately with Bearer auth and renders uploaded badge — works as designed. getMissingDocuments gates both Next (toast) and Submit (disabled) correctly.
Backend upload_driver_document/download_driver_document correctly enforces owner-or-admin access (403 for non-owner, 404 for non-existent, 200 for owner/admin).
admin_approve_driver atomically sets driver.status=active AND users.user_type=driver — verified by PUT /api/drivers/status returning 200 + /auth/me returning user_type=driver post-approval.

AdminPanel.js Approvals tab renders approval-docs-<id> section, individual view-doc-<id>-<docType> buttons, approve-btn-<id> and reject-btn-<id>; viewDocument blob fetch resolves to GET /api/drivers/documents/{id}/download with 200.
Pending drivers cannot go online — PUT /api/drivers/status?status=online returns 403 with pending-approval message.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_driver_doc_404.py (new — 2 tests for 404 non-existent doc as owner+admin)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all gates, uploads, submit, admin approve, view, post-approve online verified)

test_credentials: Created at runtime per run: qa_drv_<ts>@gmail.com / Test1234! (customer) and qa_adm_<ts>@gmail.com / Admin1234! (admin). Bearer JWT in Authorization header and localStorage.token for UI.
seed_data_creation: Fresh customer + admin + other-user per test run; one driver application created and approved in UI flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 review-request KYC features pass end-to-end. The /api/drivers/me 500 is a separate pre-existing serialization bug (exclude Mongo _id) and is the same root cause as /api/admin/users and /api/admin/orders 500s noted in iteration_9. Object storage uploads are LIVE via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY — uploads in tests hit real storage.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs in scope. Side observation: /api/drivers/me returns 500 likely because the response includes the raw Mongo document with ObjectId _id; mitigation = exclude _id from the projection or convert to str before returning.
